channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Trump rejects Iranian offer to reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: US President Donald Trump has rejected Iran’s latest proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz to shipping.

item.title: Iraq seeks US exemption from ban on Iranian flights
item.description: Ali al-Zaidi government urges dialogue to de-escalate regional tensions amid US sanctions on Iranian airlines.

item.title: At least 10 people killed in Russian and Ukrainian attacks
item.description: New strikes come as Russian FM accuses Europe of doing 'everything it can to thwart peace talks' with Ukraine.

item.title: Trump rejects Iran’s seven-day roadmap to reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Tehran submitted a proposal via Qatar to reopen the strait and resume nuclear talks within a week if Washington agreed.

item.title: The intelligence war is turning against the Houthis
item.description: Russian-Iranian intelligence helped the Houthis' offensive on the Red Sea coast. Now that system is under attack.

item.title: Trump rejects Iran deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
item.description: The US president says Tehran had only put forward the proposal because it is losing the war.

item.title: British national among six dead in building explosion close to Acropolis in Athens
item.description: Four Americans and a Greek national are among those killed in a suspected gas explosion, officials said.

item.title: Security lapses at Utah campus where Charlie Kirk was killed, review says
item.description: The indpendent report also says Kirk's aides insisted he speak outdoors, overriding concerns from campus officials.

item.title: Tenth woman's body found in South Africa suburb as police probe killings
item.description: The deaths have sparked a national outcry about the scale of violence against women in the country.

item.title: Republic of Ireland confirm rescheduled news conference before controversial Israel game
item.description: The Republic of Ireland will now hold their delayed news conference at 14:30 BST before they face Israel in tomorrow's Nations League fixture in Hungary - a fixture campaigners have called on them to boycott.
